restaurantName: Bún Chả Hương Liên (Hai Ba Trung)
address: 24 Le Van Huu Street, Phan Chu Trinh Ward, Hai Ba Trung District, Hanoi, 113000, Vietnam
bio: Playing on their claim to fame, this joint displays photos of its celebrity guests and offers a Combo Obama, which includes a fried seafood roll, a bowl of the special bún chả and a bia hà nội. The bún chả itself delivers a satisfying blend of rustic flavours, with smoky pork, meat patties, fragrant herbs and fresh salad leaves. They also serve a tasty pork skewer....
pageTitle: Bún Chả Hương Liên (Hai Ba Trung)
